title: Can a Short Video Clip Verify a Model Fix?
abstract: arXiv:2611.33393v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A developer who reproduces a video model's error on a short clip can replay that clip after an update. How often does a correct clip answer mean the original test now passes? On 960 prespecified CG-Bench questions, we updated from Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct to Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. Accuracy on a 64-frame sample spanning the full video rose from 27.9% to 33.3%. Before scoring the newer model, we froze 388 clips on which the older model reproduced its exact reference error. The updated model passed the reference on 51 of 116 clip passes (44.0%, 95% Wilson interval 35.3-53.0%) and on 16 of 272 clip failures (5.9%). Closing cases on a clip pass would have declared 65 unresolved reference failures fixed. Requiring a clip pass would have missed 16 of the 67 reference fixes (23.9%). In a separate 1,028-video study with different checkpoints and direct option scoring, only 15 clips passed, and the 16-frame reference confirmed one. For the generate

translated_title: 短视频片段能否验证模型修复？
translated_abstract: 在短视频片段上复现了视频模型错误的开发者，可以在模型更新后重放该片段。一个正确的片段答案在多大程度上意味着原始测试现已通过？在960个预先指定的CG-Bench问题上，我们从Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct更新到了Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct，覆盖完整视频的64帧样本上的准确率从27.9%提升至33.3%。在给新模型评分之前，我们冻结了388个旧模型复现了其确切参考错误的片段。更新后的模型在116次片段通过中通过了51次参考测试（44.0%，95% Wilson置信区间为35.3–53.0%），在272次片段失败中通过了16次（5.9%）。如果仅凭片段通过就关闭问题，将会宣告65个尚未解决的参考失败已被修复；而如果要求片段通过，则会遗漏67个参考修复中的16个（23.9%）。在另一项包含1,028个视频、使用不同检查点和直接选项评分的独立研究中，仅有15个片段通过，且16帧参考只确认了其中一个。
tldr: 研究表明，短视频片段不能可靠地验证视频模型的修复：仅凭片段通过就判定问题已解决会造成误判，而要求片段通过又会遗漏近四分之一的真实修复。
en_tdlr: A short video clip is an unreliable verifier of video model fixes: treating a clip pass as proof of a fix mislabels unresolved failures as fixed, while requiring a clip pass misses nearly a quarter of genuine fixes.
